Teresa \(\to\) Danielle \(\to\) Arthur \(\to\) Stephanie \(\to\) Alexander \(\to\) Karen \(\to\) Michelle \(\to \ldots \to\) John \(\to \ldots \to\) Wayne \(\to \ldots \to\) Jeremy \(\to\) Doris.  

Tracing the unique upward path from Edward yields the ancestor sequence  
Teresa \(\to\) Patrick \(\to\) Zachary \(\to \ldots \to\) Alan \(\to \ldots \to\) Dorothy \(\to \ldots \to\) Michael \(\to\) Edward.  

The two paths intersect at Teresa; consequently Teresa is a strict ancestor of both Doris and Edward. No directed path exists from Doris to Edward or from Edward to Doris, ruling out either being the ancestor of the other. No common descendant of Doris and Edward appears in the graph. The only correct statement among the five options is therefore that Doris and Edward share a common ancestor.
